test_torchserver_inference: test a detection model deployed on TorchServe by comparing local PyTorch results with server predictions
run_torchserver_comparison: run local and TorchServe inference on an image and assert bbox, label, and score equality
build_torchserver_test_args: build CLI argument parser for image, config, checkpoint, model name, inference address, and score threshold
align_torchserve_output: align TorchServe JSON response into a DetDataSample with bboxes, labels, and scores on the target device
visualize_torchserver_results: visualize and save side-by-side PyTorch and TorchServe detection results to an output directory
